scholarships.title: BatStateU Academic Excellence Scholarship – 2026
scholarships.desc:
The Batangas State University – The National Engineering University is opening applications for the Academic Excellence Scholarship Program for qualified 3rd Year College Students for Academic Year 2026–2027.

This scholarship aims to support academically outstanding students who demonstrate consistent academic performance, dedication to their studies, and active participation in university activities.

Eligibility Requirements:

Must be an officially enrolled 3rd Year student of Batangas State

requirements.title: Valid School ID
requirements.desc: Upload a clear photo of your student ID. (Max 5MB)

requirements.title: Latest Grades/Transcript
requirements.desc: Upload your latest grades or official transcript.
